title: Page 6
content_zh:
“哒哒哒！”又急又快的高跟鞋声穿过B&W整形医院的走廊，急促的声音让人们觉得那双鞋子的主人好像随时都会跌倒似的，于是连护士们都忍不住多看了几眼。
高跟鞋的主人有一双很漂亮的脚，每一根脚趾都白嫩干净，还带着一层淡淡的粉，裹着牛仔裤的小腿修长而纤细，原本套在外面的格子衬衫被系在腰间，只留下一件很随意的白色Ｔ恤遮掩着她不减丰腴的娇躯。
在B&W里，就连柜台的小护士都看得出来，这是令她们羡慕的完美身材，比例完美，背影棒得连许多明星都比不上，只可惜她一手提着化妆箱，一手捧着外带咖啡，手臂上还挂着衣服和包包，东西多又跑得急，根本没办法看清她的长相。
护士们看着她一路跑到VIP接待室，好奇又变成了祝福，只希望这个女人不要长得太好看，院长最讨厌漂亮女人了。
温宁气喘吁吁地跑进接待室，手里的咖啡还保持着热度，她轻手轻脚地放下化妆箱，接着将咖啡摆到茶几上，最后才把手臂上的东西都放下来。
但温宁气都还没有喘一口，原本倚靠在沙发上戴着眼罩休息的女人就轻轻开了口，“哎，口好渴喔。”
“那正好，咖啡还温着，可以喝。”温宁见她还戴着眼罩，就用手给自己扇了扇风，顺便在心底抱怨了一下外面糟糕的天气。
“我忽然又不想喝了，而且晚上还有摄影，咖啡会让人家肤色黯沉的。”蒙娜伸手摘下了眼罩，露出化着精致妆容的美丽脸庞，勾着红唇看向温宁，“宁姐你这么辛苦地跑了一趟，咖啡就拿来犒劳你好了。”
犒劳，温宁怎么觉得说是赏给她更合适？
蒙娜满意地看着微微愠怒却又不能发火的温宁，甜甜一笑，“不用谢我喔，宁姐。”
蒙娜虽然嘴巴甜甜地叫着姐姐，实际上却把她当成下人使唤，刚刚说了句想喝摩卡，就害她东西都没来得及放，立刻跑到几条街外的咖啡店帮她买咖啡，买回来又说不要喝了，真是……
温宁腹诽了几句脏话，在蒙娜重新戴上眼罩后，更狠狠地对着空气挥了几拳。
这个女人真是够了，年纪比她小这么多还嚣张得要命！
要不是为了自己放弃一切追求的模特儿梦想，她才不要做这个小女孩的助理呢，在二十三岁之前，从来没有人委屈过她，即使是婚后，她的生活也是十分安逸的。
但离婚后这两年，她抛弃了别人求之不得的生活，只身来到台北打拚，可以说是为了成为模特儿，但同时也是为了证明自己不是一无是处，与自己那些光鲜亮丽的姊姊一样，她也可以变得很耀眼，变成伸展台与杂志上的主角，令所有人羡慕，但转眼到了二十五岁，梦想却还是很遥远。
温宁叹了口气，将腰上的衬衫解下来套上，去外面又帮蒙娜倒了杯温水。
确定蒙娜暂时不会再使唤她之后，温宁拿起那杯咖啡走了出去。
B&W是台北首屈一指的整形医院，许多名流巨星都会选择来这里微整形，不仅如此，这家医院也很受那些长得不尽如人意的贵妇追捧。
不过这里的消费水准也是一流的，主流客层定位在上流社会，所以装潢也是高贵大气，诊疗更是采取一对一保密的形式，服务到位又贴心，尤其是大厅的那些沙发，舒适得让人一坐下去就舍不得站起来。
温宁窝在沙发里，不一会就有人送上了饮料和杂志。

离蒙娜预定的时间还有半小时，温宁看好时间后决定先看看杂志。
这本杂志好像是医院内部的宣传杂志，里面对各个医生都作了介绍，翻到其中一页的时候，温宁忽然停下了动作，大眼眨了几下之后就不动了，就这么呆呆地盯着杂志页。
五分钟后，温宁再次飞奔向接待室，开门的瞬间她捂住了自己的肚子，还貌似难受地弯下腰，“蒙娜，我有些不舒服，就……”
“先走了”几个字在抬头的瞬间被她吞回到肚子里。
接待室里面已经不只蒙娜一个人了，在她的对面多出了两个穿着白大褂的男人，一个捧着黑皮本子站在一边，另一个则坐在沙发上。
坐在沙发上的男人修长的双腿优雅地交叠，黑色皮鞋上一点灰尘都没有，和温宁记忆中一模一样，俊美无俦的五官、修长挺拔的身材，他的黑发打理得很整齐，笔挺鼻梁上的无框眼镜始终遮不住他眼底的倨傲。
这个男人从头到脚都完美得无懈可击，只不过……就在温宁不知道是该继续装肚子痛，还是扭头就走的时候，那个男人也看到了她。
肖崇源皱起好看的眉毛，冷漠的语调里充满嫌弃，“怎么是你？”
这样的语气令温宁很不高兴，她忍住满腹的抱怨，只是翻了个白眼没说话。
蒙娜的目光在他们之间游移，戴着美瞳放大片的大眼中充满好奇，“肖院长认识我的助理？”
“不认识！”温宁与肖崇源异口同声。
蒙娜和肖崇源的助理因为他们的异口同声而微微一愣。
温宁咳了咳，似乎想解释些什么，肖崇源却直接站起来，直截了当地说：“对不起，蒙娜小姐，你的手术我不能做。”
“为什么？”在蒙娜开口前，温宁忍不住脱口问。
“具体理由我的助理会和你解释，十分钟后我还有个病人要见，那么……”肖崇源的目光始终看着蒙娜，他稍稍点了点头，算是告辞。
助理余放呆呆地看着肖崇源离开接待室，无助地看向另外两个女人，他什么都不知道，该怎么解释啊？
“你以为随便谁都可以在蒙娜脸上动刀吗？”经理的咆哮透过话筒仍旧威力不减，“请不到肖崇源，就拿着辞呈来见我！”
挂了电话后，温宁头痛地哀号了一声，为什么偏偏是肖崇源？偏偏是那个三年前与她步入婚姻殿堂，两年前又不欢而散选择离婚的前夫肖崇源？
但温宁已经没有退路了，蒙娜要从模特儿界正式进军演艺圈，公司需要B&W整形医院为蒙娜的五官做微整形，如果这次请不到肖崇源出马，再加上她的合约又快到期了，那么早就看她不顺眼的经理铁定会藉机辞退她。
于是温宁不得不硬着头皮再度来到B&W，但在进到院长办公室的瞬间，温宁就后悔了。

“如果你是来让我做手术的，那么免谈。”这是肖崇源说的第一句话。
“如果是改变主意来要赡养费的，那么……”肖崇源拉开抽屉拿出支票本推到她面前。
温宁看着支票本，勉强压下怒气，“关于蒙娜的手术……”
肖崇源直接打断她，态度傲慢，“免谈。”
温宁被他堵得脸色微红，忍不住愠怒道：“为什么？难道医生还有选择病人的权……”
“因为你。”
好过分，居然第二次打断她！
肖崇源波澜不兴地看着对面满脸恼怒的小女人，“我不想再和你有任何瓜葛。”
温宁像是被一箭射中胸口，自尊劈里啪啦碎了一地，如果不是被形势所逼，她也不愿意再看到他好吗！
被前夫这么明目张胆的嫌弃，她只觉得心头发冷，费了好大的力气才忍住夺门而出的冲动。
温宁冷静了一会才逼回眼泪，缓缓道：“肖院长，希望你能公私分明。”
“公私分明？”
“是。”
“当初温暖找肖氏麻烦的时候，有没有公私分明？”
content_en:
"Ta-ta-ta-ta!" The rapid and rapid sound of high heels passed through the corridor of B&W Plastic Surgery Hospital. The rapid sound made people feel as if the owner of those shoes would fall at any time, so even the nurses couldn't help but take a few more glances.
The owner of the high-heeled shoes has a pair of beautiful feet. Each toe is white, tender and clean, with a faint layer of pink. The calves wrapped in jeans are long and slender. The plaid shirt that was originally worn outside is tied around the waist, leaving only a very casual white T-shirt to cover her plump body.
In B&W, even the little nurse at the counter can see that she has a perfect figure that they envy, with perfect proportions and a back that is not even comparable to that of many celebrities. Unfortunately, she is carrying a makeup case in one hand and a takeaway coffee in the other. There are clothes and bags hanging on her arms. There are so many things and she is running so fast that it is impossible to see her face clearly.
The nurses watched her run all the way to the VIP reception room, and their curiosity turned into blessing. They just hoped that this woman would not be too good-looking. The dean hated beautiful women.
Wen Ning ran into the reception room out of breath. The coffee in her hand was still hot. She put down the cosmetic case gently, then placed the coffee on the coffee table, and finally put down everything on her arms.
But before Wen Ning even took a breath, the woman who was leaning on the sofa wearing a blindfold and resting softly said, "Hey, I'm so thirsty."
"That's just right. The coffee is still warm and you can drink it." Seeing that she was still wearing a blindfold, Wen Ning fanned himself with his hands and complained about the bad weather outside.
"Suddenly I don't want to drink it anymore. Besides, there is photography at night, and coffee can make people's skin dull." Mona reached out and took off her eye mask, revealing her beautiful face with exquisite makeup. She looked at Wen Ning with her red lips curled up, "Sister Ning, you have traveled so hard, so I'll give you coffee as a reward."
Reward, why did Wen Ning think it was more appropriate to reward her?
Mona looked at Wen Ning, who was slightly sullen but unable to get angry, with satisfaction, and smiled sweetly, "No need to thank me, Sister Ning."
Although Mona sweetly called her sister, she actually treated her like a servant. She just said she wanted to drink mocha, but she didn't even have time to put her things away. She immediately ran to a coffee shop a few streets away to buy coffee for her. After buying it, she said she didn't want to drink it anymore. It was really...
Wen Ning swore a few curse words, and after Mona put on the blindfold again, she punched the air a few more times.
This woman is really enough, she is so much younger than her and yet so arrogant!
If she hadn't given up all her dreams of pursuing a model, she wouldn't have wanted to be this little girl's assistant. Before the age of twenty-three, no one had ever wronged her. Even after marriage, her life was very comfortable.
But in the two years after her divorce, she gave up the life that others could only dream of and came to Taipei to work hard. It could be said that she wanted to become a model, but at the same time she also wanted to prove that she was not useless. Like her glamorous sisters, she could also become very dazzling and become the protagonist on the catwalk and in magazines, making everyone envious. However, at the age of twenty-five, her dream was still far away.
Wen Ning sighed, took off the shirt around his waist and put it on, then went outside to pour another glass of warm water for Mona.
After confirming that Mona would not use her again for the time being, Wen Ning picked up the cup of coffee and walked out.
B&W is the leading plastic surgery hospital in Taipei. Many celebrities and superstars choose to come here for micro-plastic surgery. Not only that, this hospital is also very popular with ladies who are not as good as they want.
However, the consumption level here is also first-rate. The mainstream customer base is in the upper class, so the decoration is noble and elegant. The diagnosis and treatment are one-on-one confidential, and the service is in place and considerate. Especially the sofas in the lobby are so comfortable that people can’t let go of them as soon as they sit down.stand up.
Wen Ning nestled on the sofa, and soon someone brought him drinks and magazines.
There was still half an hour before Mona's scheduled time. After checking the time, Wen Ning decided to read the magazine first.
This magazine seemed to be an internal promotional magazine for the hospital. It introduced each doctor. When he turned to one of the pages, Wen Ning suddenly stopped moving. He blinked a few times and then stopped moving. He just stared blankly at the magazine page.
Five minutes later, Wen Ning rushed to the reception room again. The moment she opened the door, she covered her stomach and bent down in discomfort, "Mona, I feel a little uncomfortable, just..."
The words "Let's go first" were swallowed back into her stomach the moment she raised her head.
Mona was no longer alone in the reception room. Opposite her, there were two men in white coats. One was standing on one side holding a black leather book, and the other was sitting on the sofa.
The man sitting on the sofa had his slender legs crossed gracefully, and there was no dust on his black leather shoes. He was exactly the same as Wen Ning remembered. His handsome features, slender and straight figure, his black hair neatly styled, and the rimless glasses on the straight bridge of his nose could not hide the arrogance in his eyes.
This man was impeccable from head to toe, but...just when Wen Ning didn't know whether to continue pretending to have a stomachache or turn around and leave, the man also saw her.
Xiao Chongyuan wrinkled his beautiful eyebrows, his cold tone full of disgust, "Why is it you?"
This tone made Wen Ning very unhappy. She suppressed her complaints and just rolled her eyes without saying anything.
Mona's eyes wandered between them, her big eyes wearing enlarged contact lenses filled with curiosity, "Dean Xiao knows my assistant?"
"I don't know!" Wen Ning and Xiao Chongyuan said in unison.
Mona and Xiao Chongyuan's assistants were slightly startled by their unison.
Wen Ning coughed and seemed to want to explain something, but Xiao Chongyuan stood up and said bluntly: "I'm sorry, Miss Mona, I can't perform your surgery."
"Why?" Wen Ning couldn't help but blurt out before Mona spoke.
"My assistant will explain the specific reasons to you. I have a patient to see in ten minutes, so..." Xiao Chongyuan always looked at Mona. He nodded slightly as a farewell.
Assistant Yu Fang watched blankly as Xiao Chongyuan left the reception room and looked helplessly at the other two women. He didn't know anything. How should he explain it?
"Do you think anyone can operate a knife on Mona's face?" The manager's roar was still powerful through the microphone, "If you can't hire Xiao Chongyuan, come to me with your resignation letter!"
After hanging up the phone, Wen Ning wailed with a headache, why was it Xiao Chongyuan? It was her ex-husband Xiao Chongyuan who got married to her three years ago and divorced her two years ago?
But Wen Ning has no way out. Mona is going to officially enter the entertainment industry from the modeling world. The company needs B&W Plastic Surgery Hospital to perform micro plastic surgery on Mona's facial features. If Xiao Chongyuan cannot be hired this time, and her contract is about to expire, then the manager who has long disliked her will definitely take the opportunity to fire her.
So Wen Ning had to bite the bullet and come to B&W again, but the moment he entered the dean's office, Wen Ning regretted it.
"If you are here to let me do the surgery, then there is no need to talk." This was the first thing Xiao Chongyuan said.
"If you change your mind and ask for alimony, then..." Xiao Chongyuan opened the drawer, took out the checkbook and pushed it in front of her.
Wen Ning looked at the checkbook and barely suppressed his anger, "About Mona's surgery..."
Xiao Chongyuan interrupted her directly with an arrogant attitude, "No need to talk."
Wen Ning's face turned slightly red because of him, and he couldn't help but said angrily: "Why? Do doctors still have the right to choose patients..."
"Because of you."
How outrageous, interrupting her for the second time!Xiao Chongyuan looked at the angry little woman opposite and said unhappily, "I don't want to have anything to do with you anymore."
Wen Ning seemed to have been shot in the chest by an arrow, and her self-esteem was shattered to pieces. If she hadn't been forced by the situation, she wouldn't want to see him again, okay?
Being so blatantly disliked by her ex-husband made her feel cold, and it took a lot of effort to resist the urge to rush out of the door.
Wen Ning calmed down for a while before forcing back tears, and said slowly: "Dean Xiao, I hope you can distinguish between public and private matters."
"Distinguish between public and private affairs?"
"Yes."
"When Wen Nuan came to trouble Mr. Xiao, did he make a distinction between public and private matters?"
